title: Add filter bar or "filter as you type" to Folder View widget
line: The Folder View popup in a panel now has a search field, and typing shows only the files whose name contains the text.
explanation: The Folder View widget had no way to narrow down a long folder: typing in its panel popup only jumped the selection to the next name starting with those letters. Its drag images were also grabbed with QML grabToImage(), whose result belongs to the item, so entering a folder right after a selection could delete the item while the render thread was still grabbing it and crash plasmashell, which the filter made much more likely. FolderModel now has a filterText property (case-insensitive match on the shown name) fed by a search field in the panel popup that typing goes to, with Down, Enter and Escape handling and a "No matches" message. Drag images now go through a FolderModel helper that uses the C++ grabToImage(), whose result outlives the item.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: filter the panel popup's files as you type

Typing in the popup only jumped to the next matching name. It now has a
search field that typing goes to, so only matching files are listed, and
drag images are grabbed safely so opening a folder mid-grab can't crash.

BUG: 375222

media.caption: Before: typing "not" in the popup only moves the selection; every file stays listed
After: typing "not" goes into the new search field and only the matching files are listed
After: filter, Escape clears, type "proj" and Enter opens the folder (text cleared), filter there, Escape twice closes
